title: US delivers maritime drone to Philippine Marines
summary: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine Marine Corps has received an American-made maritime drone designed for surveillance and other naval operations as the country strengthens its maritime defense…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine Marine Corps has received an American-made maritime drone designed for surveillance and other naval operations as the country strengthens its maritime defense capabilities. US Ambassador to the Philippines Lee Lipton announced the delivery of the T38 Devil Ray manufactured by US-based Maritime Tactical Systems Inc. (MARTAC) in a post on X on Thursday. “ADVANCED MARITIME TECH DELIVERED,” Lipton said. “This is what cutting-edge, military modernization looks like with the American MARTAC T38 Devil Ray taking Philippine Marine Corps capability to the NEXT LEVEL,” he added.
